intro: Talen is a night elf amateur archaeologist encamped near the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Despite the constant danger posed by nearby naga and Horde outposts, he is dedicated to recovering ancient kaldorei relics buried along the coast.

p: Perched at a small camp on the edge of the Zoram Strand, Talen spends his days pursuing historical curiosities rather than waging war. While the wilderness of Ashenvale is fraught with territorial skirmishes and hostile shoreline denizens, Talen remains focused on gathering long-lost treasures from the ruins submerged beneath the waves and sands. He relies heavily on passing adventurers to brave the savage Wrathtail naga and retrieve elusive artifacts—including pristine statuettes and the Ring of Zoram held by the naga leader Ruuzel.
